excluded_from_repository: participant, session, coder, reviewer, and custodian names, pseudonyms, and identity mappings
direct contact, demographic, and accessibility records
privacy.freshness_attestation_boundary: The checker validates the evidence contract and the attestation binding; it cannot establish the truth of an externally held freshness or identity attestation.

required_targets.description: the prisoner as a stress test rather than the central inhabitant

disclosed_limits: The ordinary-life account rests on unimplemented families at the time of testing.
Every tested snapshot must carry its exact version identity.
The evidence is usability evidence about the tested audience, not population statistics.
Sampling and method limits bound every permitted reader claim.
No reader result enters the reasoning engine or establishes a domain assigned to another assurance route.
ethics_terms: trauma safeguards where coercive experience is discussed
independent ethics and safety review where appropriate
freshness_terms: Holdout participants have no prior exposure to drafts, previews, the pilot, or the reviews corpus.
Pilot participants are excluded from the holdout.
The in-repository reviewer corpus is never admissible reader-study evidence.
protocol.non_substitution: Reader evidence warrants only comprehension, balance, and human effects for the tested audience within the disclosed sampling and method limits.

limits: Ratification is not a reader result.
A pilot tests the instrument and supplies threshold-design evidence; it does not test release suitability.
A valid failure remains fail and leaves the claim Unestablished with evidence-pending once the route is available.
Only a matching valid fresh-holdout pass can establish the bounded reader claim.
This contract does not change Gate C wording and sends no reader result into Nibli.
